name: Aniyome Hitomi
source:
Main character moves to his brother's place to attend college. Brother is busy at work, so protagonist spends evenings just with brother's sister-in-law Hitomi. One day Hitomi overviews protagonist having sex with another girl, and bitter jealousy overwhelms her. This night their secret affair begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
